VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 23 tests pass and describes a plausible fix (per-key mutex with double-checked locking), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 23 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Manual testing claims are also unverifiable without logs or reproducible artifacts.
